description: Which consents must be captured at a checkpoint, given what the customer already holds, and whether capture is allowed at all (DECISIONS D5, C1-C3, C7). COLLECT: every missing purpose is returned; CAPTURE_BLOCKED outranks CAPTURE_REQUIRED when a needed statement is not APPROVED. verificationModes, separateActions and requiredStatementStatus are policy values the consent-service reads directly.

sections: C1 (CNS-DP + CNS-SOL at BEFORE_SUITABILITY; CNS-QSH + re-check at BEFORE_MULTI_QUOTE)
C2 (verification on the customer's own device, CNS-R13)
consent rule pack CNS-R14 (OTP valid 10 minutes), CNS-R15 (3 attempts, 5 issues per 24 hours)
related: docs/platform/architecture-review/DECISIONS-2026-10-21.md D5 (checkpoints, purposes, validity days, reuse, bindTo)

governance.signatureStatus: AI-DRAFTED - mandatory content-owner approval outstanding (ADR-024 section 7)
governance.seededBy: SUG-20261021-rul; strict defaults SUG-20261022-rdy (owner-directed build, ADMIT-BYPASS)
openItems: C1: Compliance may confirm the owner's order (consent after the questionnaire) is permissible; the relaxation is moving CNS-DP/CNS-SOL from checkpoints.BEFORE_SUITABILITY to BEFORE_MULTI_QUOTE only (configuration, no code)
C2: verificationModes = [CUSTOMER_DEVICE]; adding RM_READ_BACK needs Compliance approval
C3: separateActions = true (OPEN-CNS-01); false needs Compliance approval
C7: every statement (incl. CNS-QSH) is a draft until Compliance approves it; until then capture is CAPTURE_BLOCKED
